source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && python3 -c "
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoConfig
import json

# 1. Tokenizer check
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct', trust_remote_code=True)
print(f'Qwen-1.5B vocab: {len(tok)}')
print(f'Chat template: {tok.chat_template[:100] if tok.chat_template else \"None\"}')
print(f'Pad token: {tok.pad_token}, EOS token: {tok.eos_token}')

# 2. Data loading test
with open('/root/autodl-tmp/trace-verdict-study-data/exception_only_train.jsonl') as f:
    sample = json.loads(f.readline())
msgs = [{'role': 'user', 'content': sample['input']}, {'role': 'assistant', 'content': sample['output']}]
encoded = tok.apply_chat_template(msgs, tokenize=True)
print(f'Sample tokenization: {len(encoded)} tokens')

# 3. LoRA module check
config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained('/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct', trust_remote_code=True)
print(f'Architecture: {config.architectures}')
print(f'Hidden size: {config.hidden_size}, Num layers: {config.num_hidden_layers}')
print(f'Num attention heads: {config.num_attention_heads}')

# 4. Check linear layer names (without loading weights)
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM
import torch
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained('/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct', torch_dtype=torch.float16, trust_remote_code=True, device_map='cpu')
linear_names = set()
for name, module in model.named_modules():
    if isinstance(module, torch.nn.Linear):
        short = name.split('.')[-1]
        linear_names.add(short)
print(f'LoRA target candidates: {sorted(linear_names)}')
del model
print('DONE')
"
